design:
ATTACKED: "Execution-only self-learning loop" — parent book (819 trend today; whatever passes TASK_915 later) fixes the daily trade list; episode = one micro-notional order with deadline T∈{15,30,60} min after the daily rebalance; state = (time-left, inventory-left) + (spread, top imbalance, 5-min |ret|/vol, hour, frozen-mid flag) from the 907 recorder; actions per minute = {post at touch, post 1 tick behind, join+cross remainder, cancel/replace}; MANDATORY market cross of the remainder at T; reward = −implementation shortfall vs decision mid incl. fees; learner = Nevmyvaka-style exact backward induction (or a contextual bandit over rule parameters), NOT MuZero; training data = real post-only micro orders under the 907 phase-2 rails; deliverable = a measured maker cost tier + a two-line rule/table; CPU only. Claimed worth: ≤ +0.11 Sharpe on the trend book (21→8 bp/side), zero conditional-mean information, positive only as infrastructure; kill = STEP 0 paired shadow test on the 4.117-day capture (kill-only), STEP 1 30–60 days of real post-only orders paired with a virtual taker.

MY READ AFTER THE RECORD: it is not a self-learning loop in the operator's sense (no Monte Carlo, no self-generated targets, no iterated improvement); it is a two-arm paired A/B (post-only vs taker) plus a deterministic DP over the estimated fill surface, and the only part the record can actually run under its own rails is the static A/B.
lens: REPO-RECORD CONFLICT — refute from the repository's own evidence: LEDGER rows 812, 828s3/preflight, 835/S4-p1c, 832/E5-exit/erosion/autopsy/inversion3, 849/leaf, 857/860/879, 861, 884/885/887, 892, 898, 897; docs/findings/modeling_surface_exhausted.md; docs/findings/encoder_bella_class_closed.md; the two lore memos; goalposts docs/pathway.md:9-21; the 907 lane's own pre-registration, rails, handoffs and rulings (D65/D68/D77/D78/D79).
strongest_objection: The design's one mechanical escape from the record's HOLD attractor — the MANDATORY market cross at the deadline, which makes "do nothing" unavailable as a fixed point — is an order type the real-money contract it proposes to reuse forbids by code: `experiments/907_live_fill_probe/phase2_rails.py:170-178` `enforce_post_only` ("Never a market order, ever" — only `limit_post_only` is accepted), `tasks/TASK_907_LIVE_FILL_PROBE.md:634-636` ("auto-cancel after 1–2 bars … never a market order, ever"), D65's seed text (`tasks/DECISIONS.md` D65). The "join+cross remainder" action is forbidden the same way. So the online learner cannot be run as designed under the existing rails; a new real-money contract permitting taker orders would be a new operator ruling on a lane that is one recurring defect-shape away from a permanent halt (D78: "round 4 is the LAST patch round … no fifth round"). What CAN run under the rails is a static paired measurement — real post-only micro order vs a VIRTUAL taker at the concurrent touch — which is not a loop, adds no information a per-state average does not, and is already on record as the tactics panel's row-2 live half (`lore/fable_tactics_panel_2026-09-04.md:111-114`). Layer the goalposts on top (`docs/pathway.md:9-21`: beat +0.97 net@21 on unseen years, BEAR-positive, ≥3 seeds): the design's own ceiling is the whole cost stack, gross +0.74 → net@21 +0.56 = 0.18 (`runs/819_single_asset/POWERED_RESULT.md` FULL row), realistically +0.03–0.05 at the operator's recorded maker tier {8,16} bp (`tasks/TASK_897_CORRECTED_809_REMEASURE.md:284`), it inherits the parent's sign (898: no positive-expectancy fallback exists; TASK_820:107-117 gate 2 unseen net@8 −1.31), and it carries zero conditional-mean information by construction. As an answer to "is there a self-learning loop that could plausibly create edge" it is a "no" with a cost-measurement attached.
amplifier_check: AMPLIFIER ONLY — it creates no information. The learned object is P(fill | offset, time-left, market state) and E[drift-to-deadline | no fill, state]; both are per-state averages of realized outcomes, and Nevmyvaka's backward induction is a deterministic function of those two tables (the design itself concedes "a direct estimator … gives the SAME quantity once the state grid is fixed"). The only irreducible datum is the real fill event (queue behaviour the public L2 feed cannot resolve — `PREREGISTRATION.md:52-64` "a touch is not a fill"), and that is a MEASUREMENT (a real order), not a learning loop; at micro size the market variables evolve independently of the agent, so the "on-policy" data collection is just sampling alternative placements, which the through-print proxy can also do virtually. Worth if daily IC ≈ 0 (the memo's load-bearing doubt, adopted D79): as edge, exactly zero — E[book return] is the parent's forecast; the layer moves a negative book from ≈ −0.18 toward ≈ −0.10 at the operator's tier and cannot cross zero, cannot make anything BEAR-positive, cannot move the PIT CI[−0.13,+1.23] off zero. As infrastructure, contingent: D79/TASK_915 pre-commit that G-A failing everywhere sends the program to a DATA row (funding/basis, on-chain, news-LLM) — funding/basis is a perps book on a different venue/fee schedule/book, so a Kraken SPOT maker tier measured on 4 majors does not transfer. Under the memo's doubt the infrastructure value is near zero too, not merely the edge value. One correction that CUTS the stake further, verified: the memo's §1.4 "5 vs 10 bp adverse selection ≈ 0.3–0.5 Sharpe-points/yr" is ≈ 0.04 by the memo's own §1.1 numbers (0.1551/day × 365 × 5 bp = 2.83%/yr; book vol ≈ 65%/yr from 11.65%/yr drag ↔ 0.18 Sharpe, POWERED_RESULT.md) — the execution layer's whole stake is an order of magnitude below where the memo put it.

record_conflicts.conflict: For a FIXED parent order held ≥1 day, the post-fill markout is the parent's exposure, not execution cost: P's shortfall vs the decision reference is deterministic given the path (−half-spread + maker fee if filled; drift-to-T + half-spread + taker if not). The only adverse-selection channel that enters is the NON-FILL branch (no fill ⇔ price ran away). The design's 'learned object' (P(fill)×E[adverse markout | fill] − …) double-counts, and its repo_overlap claim that 907's estimand 1 'is exactly the direct estimator of this design's learned object' is false — estimand 1 measures a quantity that does not enter this layer's cost; only estimand 2 and drift-at-deadline do.

surviving_claim: A bounded, one-time PAIRED MEASUREMENT — real post-only micro orders on the 4 recorded majors vs a virtual taker at the concurrent touch, at the operator's recorded Kraken tier (to be looked up and written down first, because the record's taker16 and maker{8,16} are inconsistent) — is legitimate D65/gate-3 infrastructure that replaces the asserted fee16/slip5 with an observed maker tier for a daily rebalance. It carries zero conditional-mean information, inherits the parent's sign, is worth at most +0.05–0.11 Sharpe on the trend book's cost stack (realistically +0.03–0.05 at the recorded maker tier), and is mostly a fee-schedule lookup plus a first-passage statistic; the increment of ANY learner over "post at touch, wait T, cross" is unmeasured and plausibly 1–4 bp/side. It should run only if TASK_915 G-A passes and the pivot stays on Kraken spot, as the live half of the tactics panel's row 2 — never as a "self-learning loop" row, and never before 915. The honest one-line answer to the operator: no self-learning loop that learns patterns to serve Monte Carlo evaluation escapes the record's amplifier problem on this venue; the only controlled MDP available (execution) needs no loop and cannot create edge.
kill_experiment_critique: (1) STEP 0 is nearly powerless under the lane's own discipline: with `covers()`/D77-amend exclusion, T ≥ 15 min episodes without a straddled recorded gap exist only in the final ~12.8 h of the capture (handoff_run_50.md:36-43) → ≈13 independent 1-h windows per pair, one UTC-midnight slot; the 6-variable state regression and the hour-of-day term cannot be estimated; relaxing the gap rule (fills missed inside ~10% of time biases P down) is conservative for a KILL but contradicts the lane's gate-(iv) doctrine and would itself need pre-registration. (2) STEP 0's fill proxy (strictly-through) is a new estimand, not the shipped at-or-through bound (`reference_fill_model.py:50-60`); 'near-exact at micro size' is asserted. (3) K1 (unconditional saving ≥ 5 bp/side) is decided almost entirely by the operator's fee tier — a 12–16 bp maker–taker gap at mid tiers per the design's own table — minus non-fill drift; the test's information content is the fee schedule plus one first-passage probability, and its outcome straddles the bar at the recorded maker {8,16} tier, so PROCEED/KILL is a coin flip on a quantity worth ≤ +0.05 Sharpe. (4) K2 (best-minus-worst state quintile ≥ 3 bp, NW t ≥ 3, Bonferroni over a ~30-cell grid) needs thousands of NON-overlapping episodes across regimes; 30–60 days × 8 pair-sides × ~10 slots = 2,400–4,800 orders in one or two regimes is enough for the unconditional read, not for a Bonferroni-corrected state surface — K2 is likely to 'kill' for power reasons and be read as 'no surface'. (5) STEP 1 as written cannot execute the design's MDP: the terminal cross must be VIRTUAL (rails forbid market orders, `phase2_rails.py:170-178`), so the learner's action set is truncated to post-only placements and the 'beat the frozen rule by ≥ 2 bp OOS' bar compares placement variants only; deadlines of 15–60 min need the operator to set `--auto-cancel-bars` ≥ 15 against a contract text saying 1–2 bars. (6) The experiment cannot calibrate the tier the record needs: 907 covers 4 majors, while the trend book's 0.155/day turnover lives across 239–267 live assets whose half-spreads and queues are unmeasured — a majors-only tier applied to the book is the same untested-transfer error as fee16/slip5. (7) It omits the accounting it depends on: the scorer charges target-weight changes only (tactics panel correction 3: drift re-trims uncharged), so a measured per-order cost cannot be read into a Sharpe without first pre-registering the turnover decomposition. (8) Cost is inverted: the cheap step (STEP 0) is uninformative and the informative step (STEP 1: a real-order increment on a lane that has consumed four factory runs on denomination defects, under D78's no-fifth-round guard, plus 30–60 calendar days) is expensive and lands after TASK_915's 14-day kill date has already decided whether any book exists to execute. Sequencing fix if it runs at all: fold into tactics row 2, pre-register the operator's tier and the accounting first, use the 820 paper loop for the shadow half, and treat the real-order leg as gate-3 infrastructure gated on 915 G-A.
